For each reviewed item select exactly three distinct supplied artifact-local candidate_index values in final rank order.

Then use exactly one durable path per ID: save_review_decisions only for all review_ids with their exact artifact-local indices, and save_candidate_predictions only for all fallback_ids. Never include a reviewed ID in fallback saving, never overlap IDs across durable calls, never retry a rejected or completed durable write, and never write an ID twice. Do not call stage_candidate_predictions, do not save fallback predictions for the full batch, and do not process any other IDs or finalize the run.

After both durable write paths succeed, make absolutely no further MCP calls: no status verification, retrieval, preparation, or finalization.
